brief: GS's CTA flow model estimates total systematic selling roughly as large as last week, though less concentrated in North American flows than expected. The desk projects CTAs will sell $68bn of global equities over the next week and up to $106bn over the next month if prices and volatility hold near current levels; it notes these forecasts will shift as trend evolves, since markets were retracing somewhat as the note was written, but still expects trend-following flows to keep selling. Within the S&P 500, the model puts CTAs $11bn net short, with about $5.5bn of selling estimated this week. GS flags that this week's SPX flow forecast looks small given Friday's price action: although the model estimated CTAs sold nearly $51bn of SPX over the past month, elevated volatility is currently capping further selling even though the trend signal stays decidedly negative. Key SPX levels for the short, medium and long-term trend signals are given as 7560, 7527 and 7117.
